cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(sbdv CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()
include_directories(include src)
if(WIN32)
  add_executable(sbdv src/sbdv_cli_windows.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(sbdv PRIVATE shell32)
else()
  add_executable(sbdv src/sbdv_cli.cpp)
endif()
add_library(sbdv_shared SHARED src/sbdv_capi.cpp)
set_target_properties(sbdv_shared PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME sbdv CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)

# Windows deployment naming and runtime portability; classifier/API sources are unchanged.
if(WIN32)
  if(NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SBD Windows deployment requires a 64-bit compiler")
  endif()
  set_target_properties(sbdv_shared PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
  if(MINGW)
    target_link_options(sbdv_shared PRIVATE -static)
    target_link_options(sbdv PRIVATE -static)
  endif()
endif()
